body: PRIMARY INSPECTION RESULT: docs/design/gptkz-primary-source-inventory.md. The corpus route is not yet usable. Anonymous OSF GUID resolution reaches nodes/gptkz, but that node returns HTTP 401 and the rendered project redirects to sign-in. The same API returns HTTP 200 and public=true for NFRD h2pkv, so this is not a general API-authentication change. Therefore raw reproduction presence, deposit licence, and deposited chain/generation keys are Unknown; no participant content was opened or downloaded. The paper establishes that 80 handwritten reproductions per story existed, were typed for the next chain member, and retained spelling and grammatical errors, but it does not establish whether OSF holds those texts or only derived word/detail/theme scores. SECOND DECISIVE FINDING: Appendix 1 uses Bartlett's edited 328-word stimulus, whereas our fixture is the 425-whitespace-token Boas/Cultee version and its source header explicitly says Bartlett differs. Existing narrative types can nominate correspondences, but the fixture checksum, evidence spans, and some situations do not describe what participants saw. A separate source version and story artifact are required before acceptance-bearing alignment. The article is CC BY 4.0; the inaccessible dataset's licence remains Unknown. Under the chief's data-class ruling, gptkz is therefore not yet proven open and no access request will be made without owner/chief direction. I also amended the NFRD draft to reflect the chief's new public-data gate: local fetch/inspection is unblocked, while provenance, component rights, external-provider disclosure, and git admission remain separate.
